name: oh-hi-mark
description: Local Markdown review surface for Pi assistant responses

scripts.dev: bun run web:install && bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run web:install && bun run web:typecheck && bun run pi:typecheck
scripts.test: bun run web:install && bun run web:test && bun run pi:test
scripts.build: bun run web:install && bun run web:build
scripts.preview: bun run web:install && bun run --cwd web preview
scripts.release:source: bun run web:install && bun run web:typecheck && bun run web:test && bun run web:build && bun run check:generated && bun run check:generated-diff && bun run pi:typecheck && bun run pi:test
scripts.release:build: bun run web:install && bun run web:build && bun run check:generated && bun run check:generated-diff
scripts.release:validate: bun run release:source && bun run package:inspect && bun run package:smoke && bun run git:smoke && bun run browser:smoke
